Class PlayerFeedback

java.lang.Object
io.github.mcalgovisualizations.visualization.instance.PlayerFeedback
All Implemented Interfaces:
PlayerControls, AudienceChannel
public final class PlayerFeedback extends Object implements AudienceChannel, PlayerControls
Provides feedback to one or more Audience instances through sound and messages.

This class acts as a bridge between visualization controls and player-facing feedback, implementing both AudienceChannel and PlayerControls.
